name: B5 findings panel
description: Phase 1 slice B5 (findings panel): on an isolated software fixture with one unconnected resistor, Design > Run ERC fills the Findings tab; the severity filter chips show the report's counts and hide and show their severity; a finding's object reference selects that object and zooms to it in the schematic; Export CSV and Export JSON re-run ERC on the current revision and write the engine's report into the project's output folder, and the status line names the file written. Real-time DRC (slice C5), switched on in the Findings tab, runs DRC on the current revision without a Run DRC click. The Design rules dialog (C5) shows the named-rule tree and the clearance matrix; its ERC rule table disables ERC-001 (SetRuleConfig, ADR-0045) and the next ERC reports ERC-001 as DISABLED, never as passing.

Create fixture project
steps.name: B5 Findings Fixture

steps.title: Fixture: one resistor, unconnected
